allocationLaw: Derive stage usage from selected allocated stage directories and stage receipts; derive lane usage from selected allocated lane output directories including missing/incomplete summaries. Count failed/incomplete allocations. Check before create-only allocation. Selected operation is serial; do not run helpers concurrently or delete/reuse prior output. No separate counter/store.
sequence: Preserved B final failures are the before evidence. Make only selected correction, then one stage compile/generate/guard and publication1/C1-consumers3/cold2/runner1. A second stage and up to two additional lane allocations are ceilings for a concrete changed-condition correction within grant, never blind retries. A build failure stops that stage; no lane on missing/failed generation or guard. No tsc outside selected stage.

externalTemporaryEffects.preservation: Distinct empty files; preserve previous outputs and existing temporary content.

excluded: No broad rerun, required skips, ceiling increase, provider/native UAT, actual campaign invocation by author tests, Git mutation, installed mutation, test/source repair outside four paths, or speculative resource acquisition.
